About Anju

Organised service. Meaningful relationships.

Anju George Odackal serves as Administrator of Lifelight Empowerment and Education Council, Kothamangalam. Her role involves supporting the organisation’s administrative functions, coordination and institutional activities.

Through her association with Lifelight Corporate Solutions and her responsibilities in public relations, she contributes to communication, professional coordination and engagement with individuals, institutions and the wider community.

She is also involved in faith-based education as a Sunday School Teacher at St. Sebastian’s Church, Kottappady. Her working strengths include team leadership, guiding and supporting colleagues, clear communication, organisation and collaborative problem-solving.
